settings.description: Settings for the GoDaddy API client.
settings.api_secret: API secret that belongs to the key.
settings.environment: Which GoDaddy environment to call: production or ote.
settings.base_url: Full API URL. Overrides the environment when set.
settings.production_url: API URL used for the production environment.
settings.ote_url: API URL used for the OTE test environment.
settings.shopper_id: Customer shopper id for reseller calls, sent as X-Shopper-Id.
settings.timeout: Seconds to wait for a single request.
settings.max_retries: How many times a failed request is tried again.
settings.max_retry_wait: Longest wait in seconds the client accepts from a rate limit answer.
settings.backoff_base: First backoff delay in seconds, doubled on every retry.
settings.page_size: Page size used when iterating over domains.
settings.user_agent: User-Agent header. {version} is replaced with the package version.
error.missing_credentials: Missing credentials. Pass api_key and api_secret, set GODADDY_API_KEY and GODADDY_API_SECRET, or point GODADDY_CONFIG at a config file.
value.empty_name: record name must not be empty, use '@' for the apex
value.empty_type: record type must not be empty
value.no_values: at least one record value is required
value.add_needs_records: add() needs at least one DNSRecord
value.no_domains: available_many() needs at least one domain
value.update_needs_fields: update() needs at least one field to change
